name: Phantom Fortress
description: Located just miles from the Capital, the stronghold doubles as an Ironhand fortress and maximum-security prison. Its fifty-foot walls, patrolled by guards, house high-risk prisoners and reinforce the Capital’s defenses. The stronghold sports a cruciform layout surrounded by a circular wall, dividing it into four courtyards, with a wide tower at its center. The Ironhand army occupies three wings and the tower’s upper levels, while the prison takes one wing and the tower’s lower and underground floors. Once an ancient wizard’s lab, the tower’s underground now serves as an “open jail.” Prisoners roam chambers circling a dark abyss, seemingly free, yet trapped. Amenities like a sunlit garden, an Imperial propaganda-filled library, and a temple to Tamera and Bauron serve to indoctrinate them. But the ghosts haunting their sleep are the prison’s worst feature, slowly eroding mental resistance to turn prisoners into complacency. Named after these ghosts, rumored to have been slain wizards in Baleroth’s quest for mystical knowledge, the stronghold also houses special isolation cells warded by antimagic fields to deal with dangerous prisoners. Magic wards and alarms secure the entire facility. On the military front, hundreds of soldiers stand ready to quell any military threat or escape attempts. A ritual chamber exists at the top of the tower, used for converting individuals into Ironhand soldiers by psychosurgery using tameranium and bauronite to strip them of free will. Many criminals, rebels, and captured spies are sent to this fortress, which also makes it a target for prison break attempts. The allied forces have a deep interest in releasing a few of the prisoners that are here. At the same time, the Empire uses this place to extract information or keep individuals who can be held for ransom, possessing value for other political forces. Some scholars believe that the ghosts here are bound by powerful magic from Baleroth himself, and they hold unique knowledge about the psychosurgery that creates Ironhands. Rumors say freeing these souls could allow one to gain their vast arcane knowledge or mystical powers.
